### Step 1: Understand the Direction of Rotation

When the skater spins **to her right**, she is rotating **clockwise**. This is because, if you face north and turn to your right (clockwise), you end up facing east.

---

### Step 2: Determine the Net Rotation

A full circle is 360 degrees. So, we first find how many full circles are in 2250 degrees:

$$
2250 \div 360 = 6.25
$$

This means the skater has made **6 full rotations** (each 360 degrees) and an additional **0.25 of a rotation**, which is:

$$
0.25 \times 360 = 90 \text{ degrees}
$$

So, the net rotation is **90 degrees clockwise**.

---

### Step 3: Determine the Final Direction

Starting from **north**, a **90-degree clockwise rotation** leads to:

- **North → East** (90° clockwise)

So, after this rotation, the skater is facing **east**.

---

\boxed{east}
$$
